request.task: Find the official product page of the manufacturer or brand owner for the food product 'VALIO PROFEEL PROTEINDRINK DISPLAY CARDB', and read it. Report only what that page states. product_name_on_page and page_title: exactly as the page shows them. source_url: the address of that page. contains: each allergen the page names in its allergen information or marks in the ingredient list (for example in bold). may_contain: each allergen of a 'may contain' or traces statement. free_from: each allergen the page says the product is free from (for example gluten-free, milk-free, lactose-free). Use the page's own words. Leave a list empty when the page says nothing for it. Set page_found to false when no page of this product is found.
